subject: Collection path proposal — authorize wire or virtual-pay split

Subject: Collection path proposal — authorize wire or virtual-pay split

Hi Priya / StrataCore AP,

Following up on INV-332 (due 12/02) — we haven't seen settlement come through yet and wanted to propose a short, low-friction path to close the balance by end of next week. Suggested options:

1) Straight wire for full amount (fastest) — we can provide beneficiary details and a short wire authorization form.
2) Split-payment: virtual card for up to $25k and wire for the remainder (if AP portal supports virtual card acceptance).

If wire is easiest for you, please confirm and we will send a pre-filled wire-authorization DocuSign (one-click approval from your AP). If split, please confirm portal readiness and we will issue a split invoice.

Proposed timeline:
- Confirm preferred method by EOD Mon 12/07
- Target funds out 12/09 to avoid month-end reconciliation churn

For reference I've attached the invoice (invoice_INV332.pdf).

Thanks — small asks below so we can unblock quickly:
- Confirm wire or split (one-line)
- If wire: who is the AP contact (name/email) authorized to sign wire forms?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0123

Karthik,

Thanks for the note and the invoice. We can do a wire for the full amount, but AP will need the following before release:

- Completed W-9 or equivalent vendor tax form (we have it on file but need a dated copy)
- Pre-filled wire authorization with beneficiary name, account number, and beneficiary address
- Payment reference (please confirm invoice number we should use)

We typically don't run virtual-card payments through our portal unless the vendor is already tokenized there; if you can send a split invoice that calls out amounts, we can take a quick look — but our default will be wire.

Target: we can queue for payment in the 12/09 run provided the documents above are received by EOD Mon 12/07.

AP contact for signatures: Rohit Mehra <rohit.mehra@stratacore.com> (Accounts Payable Lead).

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Finance Ops Manager
StrataCore
